summary: Davao-born Pentecostal preacher Apollo Quiboloy founded the Kingdom of Jesus Christ in 1985, declared himself the Appointed Son of God, and used it to traffic girls and workers between the Philippines and the US under Duterte's protection until his 2024 arrest.

evidence.note: 1970s work as preacher sidekick to a Marcos-era official; expelled by his denomination in 1979
breaks away in 1985 with about fifteen followers to found the KOJC
church money helps launch Duterte's career as Davao mayor in 1988
pastoral system funnels girls as young as eleven to him, per 2018-era FBI indictment
Children's Joy Foundation used for fake charity solicitation and visa fraud from 2007
followers ordered into divorces and sham marriages to obtain US visas
trafficked workers have passports taken and communications monitored
2008 killing of an indigenous landowner and his children near the compound
Hawaii escapee report in 2015 and 2018 California jet raid
2024 police siege of the Davao compound and surrender after about two weeks

notes: No theme for human trafficking; covered by slavery-forced-labor plus immigration-borders (visa fraud), the latter a loose fit. main_span ends at the 2024 arrest since he was in custody at release. Duterte's lifespan is from general knowledge. Hawaii and California both matter, so no single US subdivision. Transcript renders Mount Apo as Mount Oppo.
